XDP BPF program generation and installation for UDP port filtering and XSK map setup.

# Purpose
This header file declares the interface for XDP program generation and installation. It defines `fd_xdp_fds_t`, which stores the file descriptors for the XSK map and the BPF link used to keep the XDP program attached to a network interface. It also declares [`fd_xdp_gen_program`](<#fd_xdp_gen_program>), which builds a BPF program for UDP traffic on selected ports, and [`fd_xdp_install`](<#fd_xdp_install>), which installs that program on an interface and returns the file descriptors needed to manage the XSK sockets. The comments describe the packet filter rules, the optional IPv4 destination filter, and the failure behavior of the install function.
# Function Declarations (Public API)

---
- `fd_xdp_gen_program`
- `fd_xdp_install`
